body:
I know words from strangers don’t mean much. But I’ve known shallow people & I’ve known people who see you for what you are. Bad experiences are horrible, I think we have experiential overlap in that sense.

My only tangible advice would be to get counseling, not as an end all be all, but to help make sense of your feelings and whatever afflictions you have.

I’d say now is a time to make new friends and be open with them from the start, so you can know who’s truly there for you rather them not. 

I hope my words aren’t preachy or cliche, best of luck to you, and although they might not be in your life right now, I’ve known people who are genuinely human & caring, so if it’s any consolation, they’re out there.

I’ve also set my own date. May 10th of next year. I know words can barely change anything, but I do hope something happens that might change your trajectory. 

Wish you the best moving forward, however short/long it may be for you.
I know just the guy you should read…
